title: Pennsylvania PALS accountancy and real-estate licensees
hypothesis: The implemented PA PALS recipe-C route can retain an active individual Accountancy or Real Estate Commission licensee with a published register phone candidate. A licence and its phone do not establish business ownership, a direct business role for the phone, or handset ownership.
ownerSource: PA PALS supplies an active individual licence record for Accountancy or Real Estate Commission. It is credential evidence only: the licensee remains an owner candidate until independent owner or founder evidence is matched to the same business.
phoneSource: The PALS PhoneNo1 field is an implemented register-phone candidate. The fixture/code audit establishes parser retention only; it does not establish that the number is mobile, reachable, a published business contact, or direct to the licensee.

workflow.label: PA PALS person search
workflow.detail: Read a surname-page response from the implemented person endpoint; retain source provenance and keep the register phone distinct from ownership evidence.

workflow.label: Active profession and person filter
workflow.detail: Keep active individual Accountancy or Real Estate Commission rows; reject all other professions, inactive rows, and rows lacking a parseable first and last name.

workflow.label: Licence out of scope
workflow.detail: Hold non-active, other-profession, facility, or incomplete-person rows.

workflow.label: Licensed-person candidate
workflow.detail: Preserve licence type and business type, but do not call the licensee an owner.

workflow.label: Register phone candidate
workflow.detail: Use PhoneNo1 only as a contact candidate; missing, malformed, or shared contacts remain out of recipe C.

workflow.label: Line and compliance gates
workflow.detail: Require mobile classification, reachability, DNC/TCPA clearance, suppression, duplicate, freshness, and timezone checks.

workflow.label: Contact gate hold
workflow.detail: Hold non-mobile, unreachable, DNC/TCPA, suppressed, duplicate, stale, shared, or timezone-unresolved contacts.

workflow.label: Independent owner and direct-contact evidence
workflow.detail: A future owner-labelled delivery requires current independent owner or founder evidence for the matched business and an explicit direct business-role link to this phone.

workflow.label: Ownership unresolved
workflow.detail: Hold credential-only, employee, associate-broker, front-desk, conflicting, or unlinked-contact evidence; do not infer handset ownership.

workflow.label: Future owner-confirmed delivery
workflow.detail: Deliver only after the generic contact gates and separate owner/direct-contact evidence both pass.

edges.label: status, profession, or person test fails
owner or direct-contact evidence missing or conflicts

failures.risk: A PALS licensee is presented as the owner of a business.
failures.mitigation: Treat the licence as credential evidence and require independent owner or founder evidence matched to the business.

failures.risk: An associate broker, CPA employee, or other licensed professional is treated as an owner.
failures.mitigation: Preserve the licence role and hold every credential-only row until an owner-specific source supports the same business and person.

failures.risk: PhoneNo1 is presented as a direct owner handset or a published business line.
failures.mitigation: Keep register-phone provenance separate and require explicit direct business-role linkage before an owner-contact label.

failures.risk: A surname search silently omits records after PALS reports 500 records.
failures.mitigation: Retain the adapter cap note and measure coverage with a separate lawful sampling plan; do not claim statewide completeness.

failures.risk: Generic recipe-C delivery bypasses the unresolved ownership question.
failures.mitigation: Hold pa_licensee rows before delivery unless a supported owner-evidence assessment is stored; leave the export owner field empty for credential-only records.

iterations.hypothesis: The PALS parser keeps an active in-scope licensed person and phone candidate while rejecting an out-of-scope profession.
iterations.test: Five-case local fixture/code audit on 2026-09-24: parse the first five saved PALS fixture rows through paPals. Command used node --experimental-strip-types with tests/fixtures/registers/pa_pals.json; no network, credential, provider, contact-data export, or paid call ran.
iterations.observed: 4/5 rows were active Real Estate Commission person rows and were retained with a parsed phone candidate; 1/5 Auctioneer Examiners row was held as profession_out_of_scope. The existing focused pa_pals register test also passed. This is parser behavior only, not a measurement of ownership, handset ownership, line type, reachability, DNC/TCPA, or delivery.
iterations.change: Document PALS records as licensed-person and phone candidates only; add an owner-evidence hold before any owner-labelled pa_licensee delivery.

measurement.result: Five saved PALS fixture rows: four active Real Estate Commission person rows retained with a parsed phone candidate; one Auctioneer Examiners row held as out of scope. Local fixture/code audit only; no live source, phone, owner, handset, compliance, or delivery measurement.

cost.basis: Local five-case fixture/code audit only; no source fetch, provider, append, trace, review, or phone-verification call ran.
cost.note: No clean owner contact was measured. The historical brain benchmark has a different denominator and does not establish a clean-contact cost.

implementation.summary: PA PALS parsing and generic recipe-C contact/compliance gates are implemented. pullNames writes the licensee into owner_name and settleVerified can deliver the row after generic gates without owner-evidence or direct-contact proof, so owner-confirmed delivery is not implemented.

nextMeasurement: After an owner-evidence hold is wired, run a lawful 5–20 row aggregate study only on a catalog-verified public business-contact endpoint. Separate active scoped licence, business match, independent owner support, explicit direct-business-contact support, mobile, reachable, DNC/TCPA-clear, suppression/duplicate-clear, and delivered denominators; do not use residential, property, private-phone, paid, or restricted-list sources.
